name: MENSS
product_facts: Range: Menss Care Cream (live on menss.co and suamisihat.com.my; topical daily intimate skin care cream with Tongkat Ali Physta and BioKesum, KKM notification NOT250807222K), FRESH Wash (personal care), Penile Pump (vacuum device, integrated with SS Clinic doctor-supervised protocols), Ring Series (silicone rings), Noctis and Scensual (in development, no approved assets)
Live-site bundles for Menss Care Cream (menss.co): Sologrip (1 Unit, RM 89.00 / reg RM 99.00), Double Power (2 Unit, RM 169.00 / reg RM 198.00), Triple Impact (3 Unit, RM 249.00 / reg RM 297.00)
color_rules: White on Precision Cyan is 3.5:1; use black text on cyan buttons
Do not use cyan for body text on light backgrounds

fonts.display: Poppins SemiBold / Bold; Montserrat for subtitles and labels

rules: Do not place the logo on photographs without a solid panel
Clear space = cap height; min 90 px / 22 mm wide
Pump packaging uses the Pump sub-brand mark

graphic_device: Precision Lines (pattern.svg): fine diagonal cyan lines on Carbon, line weight/opacity never above 50%, copy on solid areas
doctor_allowed_in_ads: not addressed; check with SS Clinic rules
source: SuamiSihat Design System repo (static/products/<slug>/metadata.json, docs/claims-review/README.md and audit-2026-10-13.md), brand guideline v1.0 PDFs (16 Oct 2026), and live site https://menss.co/
staff_claims_review: Device descriptions such as 'medical-grade' or 'vascular rehabilitation' need registration evidence before public use

Menss Care Cream (live on menss.co, KKM NOT250807222K): notified as a cosmetic. Do not copy 'Pancut Awal', erection/hardness or unapproved 'kajian klinikal' / Physta / BioKesum efficacy claims from menss.co into ad scripts without brand-owner sign-off.
planned: White-label MENSS ring in blue, using the same ring tooling (FAI AMS-26043, which is marked MENSS). Future plan, no approved assets yet.
